faqs.q: How long should I wait before following up on a deal?
faqs.a: Five days is a sensible start: long enough that you are not chasing, short enough that the deal is still warm. Change it in one sentence, for example 3 days for big deals and 7 for small ones.

faqs.q: Will it email my contacts without asking me?
faqs.a: No. Every follow-up waits in Needs you until you approve it, change it or decline it. AI agents ask before sending, even to you, until you allow otherwise in Settings. See [How to make an AI agent ask before it acts](/guides/how-to-make-an-ai-agent-ask-before-it-acts).

faqs.q: How does it know a deal has gone quiet?
faqs.a: It starts from your Gmail threads: emails you sent that got no answer. It then finds the matching contact and deal in HubSpot and leaves out deals that are won, lost or answered.

faqs.q: Does it change anything in HubSpot?
faqs.a: It reads deals, contacts and notes. Adding a note to a contact is a change in an outside app, so that asks you first too.

faqs.q: Does it run the moment a contact goes quiet?
faqs.a: No. An AI agent runs on a schedule, here every weekday at 9:00, or when you ask it in its chat. It does not react to each email as it arrives.

faqs.q: What does it cost to start?
faqs.a: 50agents is free to start. Tell Captain what you want, read the plan, and tap Build it. The AI agent is not built before that.

faqs.q: What if it drafts a follow-up to the wrong person?
faqs.a: It is only a draft. Each one waits in Needs you with the contact and deal it matched, so you can change it or decline it before anything is sent.

faqs.q: Does it work with Pipedrive or Salesforce instead of HubSpot?
faqs.a: Both are in the catalog, and 50agents works with 2,300+ apps through viaSocket. Name your CRM in your sentence to Captain and ask what it can read.

faqs.q: How do I stop or change it?
faqs.a: Tell its chat what to change, such as the wait or the tone of the follow-up. Its instructions and memory are visible, so you can correct or forget anything it learned.

faqs.q: Can HubSpot send automatic follow-up emails by itself?
faqs.a: Yes, with sequences, which need Sales Hub or Service Hub on a Professional or Enterprise plan and a Sales or Service seat. A sequence sends a set series of emails and, by default, stops when the contact replies. This AI agent reads which deals went quiet and drafts a follow-up for each, waiting in Needs you. If you already have sequences and want fixed timing, use them.
